title: MEBench: A Novel Benchmark for Understanding Mutual Exclusivity Bias in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on synthetic images containing combinations of known and novel objects, prompting them with a novel label (e.g., a pseudo-word like 'dax'), and measuring the probability that the model correctly associates the novel label with the novel object rather than a known one (calculated via a normalized ME score).
